name: Block Craft Racing
summary:
Block Craft Racing is a voxel-style, arcade kart racer built for Meta Quest. Race blocky karts through three vibrant worlds – sunny beach, icy tundra, and fiery lava – all rendered in charming low-poly, block-style visuals. Collect coins to upgrade and unlock dozens of toy cars, and master drift boosts and tricks on wildly customizable tracks. With simple pick-up-and-play controls and progressively challenging time-trial cups, every player can enjoy Block Craft Racing’s fast-paced fun.
